findings.finding: Skills key directly by sense_id; curriculum revision is absent. Distinct inform ID avoids automatic reuse of notify evidence only if no future alias/copy/merge migration is introduced.

Context keys include curriculum revision, requirements keys include requirements revision, and fingerprints include term/skill requirements plus expression IDs but no expression wording. Changing a sense under an already-pinned requirements revision is rejected; a text-only edit is invisible. A fresh namespace is necessary.

The current validator couples every course curriculum revision to the catalog, and every module requirements revision to its course. A new global namespace therefore updates all twenty course and all two hundred module revision values. Keeping other modules on mixed revisions requires a separately accepted contract change. Do not confuse twenty content substitutions with the complete migration scope.

Saved skills are validated structurally without requiring current membership. Old requirement fingerprints, expression dictionaries and completions can remain historical. New events must match selected requirements; retired notify is rejected in the new inform module, not necessarily in previously registered old contexts.

Event receipts retain payload fingerprints and reject modified reuse of an event ID. Outbox recovery credits the saved professional:<event-id> wallet receipt before acknowledgement without a new membership check. Preserve receipts and pending outbox entries unchanged; never replay or translate them as inform.

Course totals and module badges count historical course/module completions across revisions; detail reads current requirements. Historical completion and newly required work can coexist. Do not erase earned receipts to force visual alignment.

A loaded lexeme with no memberships causes membership.orphan. Retire notify from loaded envelopes during the coordinated swap and retain the exact original entry/source/hold outside catalog-loaded data; no dummy membership.

Runtime signatures omit contextual atomic/stem type when canonical identity/form match. A new proposed canonical ID isolates identity but does not settle family classification or approve the pending clinical morph.inform stem.

Media manifests bind curriculum context, generated domain payloads include course content and release inventories, and the domain owner checks course/media revision. Final source/supporting/contract and media dependencies must be rebound on the accepted integrated state.
